summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for email allowlist, role-based access, audit logging, and logo integration. All 25 backend pytest cases and all role-based UI checks passed. Admin/muhasebe/ogretmen roles behave as specified in both API permissions and sidebar/nav rendering. Audit log entries are created for admin actions and returned with correct user_name, user_role, and detail. Sidebar & document (contract/receipt) logos render from /assets/logo.jpeg.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py TestRBAC endpoints depend on shared DB state (role field on the seeded test user). This is fine for tests, but note that pytest-xdist parallel workers (configured in /app/backend/pytest.ini with -n 2 --dist loadscope) can cause race conditions if additional role-toggling test files run in parallel. Currently the single test module keeps class-level ordering, so tests pass sequentially with -n 0. Consider using distinct test users per role to enable safe parallelism.

server.py: /auth/session assigns EMAIL_ROLES[email] on first sign-in but on subsequent logins uses existing['role'], meaning if an admin's role was demoted, they cannot be re-elevated via allowlist automatically. Acceptable but worth documenting.

server.py: log_action for auth.login is fired inside /auth/session which is good. However /users PUT role has no self-demotion guard; an admin can demote themselves and lose access. Consider blocking it (already blocked in FE via `disabled={u.user_id === me?.user_id}` but backend allows it).
No pagination on /audit-logs beyond limit=200 default; acceptable for MVP.
Frontend Documents kind state persists across renders correctly; consider using `?student_id=` in URL for print flows.
